summary: Defined workflow schema and persistence layer for visual editor state. Created TypeScript interfaces (Workflow, WorkflowNode, WorkflowConnection, WorkflowNodeType, WorkflowNodePosition, CreateWorkflowInput, UpdateWorkflowInput) in src/types/workflow.ts. Added Neo4j schema initialization with unique constraints and composite indexes for Workflow, WorkflowNode, and WorkflowConnection labels in GraphManager.initialize(). Implemented WorkflowPersistenceService with async CRUD methods (createWorkflow, getWorkflowById, listWorkflows, updateWorkflow, deleteWorkflow) using transactional Neo4j queries following existing service patterns.
